Immutable source lineage; computation uses approved atom bindings.

ports.name: slides
ports.constraints: Ordered decoded RGB uint8 raster and aligned binary uint8 mask pairs. Caller defines foreground meaning and physical scale. Source preparation uses unshifted and half-shifted grids, JPEG roundtrip, std>10 filtering and rounded-area bins. Both foreground-bin and background-bin training populations must remain.

ports.name: groups
ports.constraints: One string or integer group label per labeled raster. Validation groups hold out whole rasters before tiling; both partitions must retain tiles. Caller must establish subject/acquisition independence and exclude validation overlap from pseudo sources.

ports.name: initial_stages
ports.constraints: Nonempty ordered FoldStage objects with explicit full encoder tensor state, integer model seed, validation group labels and training options. Options include positive ordered start/end epochs, maximum_bin, batch sizes, input_side, explicit Python Random, NumPy RandomState and CPU Torch Generator. Training batch size is at least2 and model input dimensions are multiples of32. Every fold constructs a fresh decoder, Adam optimizer and scheduler.

ports.name: initial_selectors
ports.constraints: Nonempty ordered pairs of configured fold index and actually produced checkpoint role. Roles are best_loss, best_score or snapshot_<epoch>. These stage adapters do not perform the separate run_lifecycle selector precheck. Invalid selectors must not be supplied; tensor-compatible checkpoints do not establish pretrained provenance.

ports.name: tile_size
ports.constraints: Integer tile side at least2; source default1024. Both source grid offsets must produce a nonempty grid for each raster. Tile scale changes target meaning and sampling, so application transfer requires justification.

ports.name: input_resolution
ports.constraints: Positive integer model input side compatible with the network, normally320 and a multiple of32. It must agree with inference_geometry.input_resolution. This interface does not check that agreement before model execution.

ports.name: pseudo_sources
ports.constraints: Ordered collections of decoded RGB uint8 rasters from caller-approved pseudo populations. Caller must prevent validation overlap. Four-view predictions become binary masks; only rounded-bin-positive pseudo tiles are later appended to training.

ports.name: pseudo_rng
ports.constraints: Mapping with python_rng as Python Random and torch_generator as CPU Torch Generator. Streams are consumed by inference; callers control and preserve their lifecycle. No hidden global seed or device scheduling equivalence is promised.

ports.name: inference_geometry
ports.constraints: None or a mapping containing only resolution, input_resolution, pad_size and batch_size. Defaults are1024,320,256,12. Positive integer sizes and batch size are required; padding must satisfy0<=pad_size<resolution/2. Model and inference input resolution must agree; whole decoded input and output rasters remain resident.

ports.name: retraining_stages
ports.constraints: Nonempty ordered FoldStage objects with the same explicit encoder, grouping, schedule and RNG contract as initial stages. Retraining constructs fresh model/optimizer state and appends positive pseudo tiles; it does not continue the initially trained segmentation model.

ports.name: final_selectors
ports.constraints: Nonempty ordered pairs of retraining fold index and actually produced checkpoint role, preserving ensemble order. Callers must select checkpoints produced by their explicit schedule. Historical notebook checkpoint selection is not authenticated by shape compatibility.

ports.name: final_images
ports.constraints: Ordered decoded nonempty RGB uint8 rasters for final prediction. Foreground semantics, color/normalization, physical scale and augmentation invariance must be justified for the new application.

ports.name: final_rng
ports.constraints: Mapping with python_rng as Python Random and torch_generator as CPU Torch Generator, consumed during final inference. These are mutable trusted runtime objects, not JSON values.

ports.name: initial_metrics
ports.constraints: Ordered per-fold epoch records with training and validation aggregates plus checkpoint/early-stop decisions. These are training diagnostics, not independent predictive-quality evidence.

ports.name: retraining_metrics
ports.constraints: Ordered per-fold epoch records after fresh training with positive pseudo tiles. Validation metrics do not prove independence of caller-supplied populations.

ports.name: predictions
ports.constraints: Ordered full-raster uint8 binary masks using three flip views, model averaging, resize, strict threshold0.5 and interior stitching. Empty masks may reflect the batch classifier shortcut. Outputs are not calibrated uncertainty estimates.
